description:
Business Overview
RawDrive requires a comprehensive automated onboarding system which should be a microservice with KEDA auto scaling to streamline customer acquisition and reduce time-to-value. The system must guide new users through account creation, payment processing, and initial setup with minimal friction while ensuring security, compliance, and user engagement.

Business Objectives
Reduce Churn: Provide guided setup to help customers get value quickly
Increase Conversion: Streamline signup with minimal barriers
Ensure Compliance: Collect necessary agreements and verify customer information
Automate Operations: Minimize manual intervention in customer setup
Collect Data: Gather essential information for account setup and personalization
Facilitate Payment: Integrate payment processing seamlessly into the signup flow
Functional Requirements
FR-1: Plan Selection Interface
Description: Customers must be able to select their subscription tier before creating an account.

Requirements:

Display plan cards with features, pricing, and billing cycles
Support monthly and annual billing with savings calculation
Persist selected plan through the entire onboarding flow
Provide clear feature comparison matrix
Include accessibility features for screen readers and keyboard navigation
FR-2: User Registration
Description: Collect and validate user information for account creation.

Requirements:

Support email/password registration and Google OAuth
Validate email uniqueness and format
Enforce strong password policies (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special chars)
Require email verification before account activation
Collect business information (name, description, website)
Include terms of service and privacy policy acceptance
Support account linking for existing users
FR-3: Payment Processing
Description: Securely process subscription payments.

Requirements:

Integrate with payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, etc.)
Support multiple payment methods (credit cards, digital wallets, bank transfers)
Implement PCI DSS compliance measures
Provide real-time payment validation and error handling
Generate order summaries with tax calculations
Support multiple currencies and regional payment methods
FR-4: Payment Verification and Webhook Processing
Description: Verify payment completion and handle webhook notifications.

Requirements:

Process payment gateway webhooks for status updates
Implement idempotency to handle duplicate webhook events
Support exponential backoff retry logic for failed processing
Update subscription status based on payment confirmation
Send payment confirmation emails with invoice details
FR-5: Automatic Tier Activation
Description: Instantly activate subscription benefits upon successful payment.

Requirements:

Create subscription records with billing cycle and renewal dates
Initialize resource limits based on selected tier
Grant tier-specific features and permissions
Update user account with subscription information
Send tier activation confirmation emails
FR-6: Guided Setup Wizard
Description: Provide step-by-step guidance for initial account configuration.

Requirements:

Present welcome screen with product overview
Guide profile setup (business info, branding, contact details)
Assist with first gallery creation
Allow progress saving and resumption
Provide skip options for optional steps
Include tooltips and help text throughout
FR-7: Email Communications
Description: Send automated emails throughout the onboarding process.

Requirements:

Email verification during registration
Payment confirmation with invoice attachment
Tier activation confirmation
Welcome emails with next steps
Support email templates with branding
Include unsubscribe options for marketing emails
Non-Functional Requirements
NFR-1: Performance
Page load times < 2 seconds
Payment processing completion < 30 seconds
Email delivery within 5 minutes of trigger events
Support concurrent onboarding sessions for 1000+ users
NFR-2: Security
Implement TLS 1.3 for all data transmission
Encrypt sensitive data at rest using AES-256-GCM
Comply with PCI DSS for payment processing
Implement CSRF protection and rate limiting
Support 2FA for enhanced account security
NFR-3: Scalability
Handle peak signup periods (1000+ concurrent users)
Support horizontal scaling across multiple servers
Implement database connection pooling
Cache frequently accessed data (plans, pricing)
NFR-4: Reliability
99.9% uptime for onboarding flows
Automatic retry mechanisms for failed operations
Graceful error handling with user-friendly messages
Database transaction consistency across all steps
NFR-5: Usability
Mobile-responsive design for all devices
Support for 10+ languages and locales
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance
Progressive enhancement for older browsers
NFR-6: Compliance
GDPR compliance for EU users (data collection consent)
CCPA compliance for California users
SOC 2 Type II audit readiness
Regular security assessments and penetration testing
User Stories
US-1: Plan Selection
As a prospective customer
I want to compare subscription plans
So that I can choose the best option for my business

Acceptance Criteria:

Plan cards display pricing, features, and billing cycles
Monthly/annual toggle updates pricing dynamically
Feature comparison matrix is available
Selected plan persists through registration
US-2: Account Registration
As a new user
I want to create an account securely
So that I can access RawDrive services

Acceptance Criteria:

Email verification required before account activation
Password strength indicator provides real-time feedback
Google OAuth integration pre-fills user information
Terms and privacy policy acceptance is required
Business information collection is mandatory
US-3: Payment Processing
As a customer
I want to complete payment securely
So that my subscription is activated immediately

Acceptance Criteria:

Multiple payment methods are supported
Payment form is PCI compliant
Order summary shows all charges and taxes
Error messages are clear and actionable
Payment confirmation is immediate
US-4: Guided Setup
As a new user
I want to configure my account step-by-step
So that I can start using RawDrive effectively

Acceptance Criteria:

Setup wizard has clear progress indicators
Profile setup includes branding options
First gallery creation is guided
Setup can be paused and resumed
Skip options available for optional steps
Data Requirements
DR-1: User Data Collection
Personal information: name, email, phone
Business information: company name, description, website
Authentication data: password hash, OAuth tokens
Subscription data: plan ID, billing cycle, payment method
DR-2: Audit Trail
Track all onboarding steps with timestamps
Log payment attempts and outcomes
Record email communications sent
Maintain user consent records
DR-3: Business Intelligence
Conversion funnel analytics
Drop-off points identification
Payment method preferences
Setup completion rates
Integration Requirements
IR-1: Payment Gateway Integration
Webhook endpoints for payment status updates
Secure API key management
Support for multiple currencies
Fraud detection integration
IR-2: Email Service Integration
SMTP or transactional email service
Template management system
Delivery tracking and analytics
Bounce and unsubscribe handling
IR-3: Identity Provider Integration
Google OAuth 2.0 / OIDC compliance
User profile data mapping
Account linking logic
Token refresh handling
Success Metrics
Conversion Rate: Percentage of visitors who complete onboarding
Time to Value: Average time from signup to first gallery creation
Payment Success Rate: Percentage of successful payment completions
User Satisfaction: NPS scores from onboarding surveys
Churn Reduction: Decrease in trial-to-paid conversion drop-off
Risk Mitigation
Payment Failures: Implement retry logic and alternative payment methods
Data Loss: Regular backups and transaction consistency
Security Breaches: Multi-layer security and regular audits
User Confusion: Clear UI/UX with help documentation
Technical Issues: Monitoring, alerting, and rollback procedures
Implementation Priority
High Priority: Core registration and payment flow
Medium Priority: Guided setup wizard and email communications
Low Priority: Advanced features (social login, multi-language support)
Testing Requirements
Unit tests for all business logic components
Integration tests for payment processing
End-to-end tests for complete onboarding flows
Performance testing under load
Security testing and vulnerability assessments
User acceptance testing with real customers
Maintenance and Support
Regular security updates and patches
Payment gateway integration monitoring
Email deliverability monitoring
Performance optimization based on usage patterns
Customer support escalation procedures for onboarding issues
Future Enhancements
AI-powered plan recommendations
Progressive profiling for additional data collection
Advanced analytics and personalization
Mobile app onboarding flows
Integration with CRM systems for lead nurturing
title: Automated User Onboarding Requirements

# Comprehensive Specification: RawDrive Automated Onboarding System

## 1. Problem Statement

New RawDrive customers currently face a fragmented signup experience that requires manual intervention for account setup, payment processing, and initial configuration. This leads to high drop-off rates during registration, delayed time-to-value, and increased support burden. The platform needs a streamlined, automated onboarding flow that guides users from plan selection through payment to their first gallery creation.

## 2. User Story

**Primary**: As a professional photographer, I want to sign up for RawDrive, complete payment, and set up my workspace in one seamless flow, so that I can start uploading and managing my photos immediately.

**Secondary**: As a platform administrator, I want new user onboarding to be fully automated with proper compliance tracking, so that customer acquisition scales without manual intervention.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria

### Happy Path - Complete Onboarding Flow
- **GIVEN** a visitor lands on the pricing page
- **WHEN** they select a plan, complete registration, and submit payment
- **THEN** their subscription is activated immediately, workspace is created, and they enter the guided setup wizard

### Happy Path - Google OAuth Registration
- **GIVEN** a visitor selects Google OAuth during registration
- **WHEN** they authenticate with Google and complete plan selection/payment
- **THEN** their account is created with pre-filled information from their Google profile

### Edge Case - Existing Email Registration Attempt
- **GIVEN** a user tries to register with an email that already exists
- **WHEN** they submit the registration form
- **THEN** they see a clear message with options to login or reset password

### Edge Case - Payment Method Declined
- **GIVEN** a user's payment method is declined
- **WHEN** they submit payment
- **THEN** they see a specific error message and can retry with a different payment method

### Edge Case - Webhook Duplicate Processing
- **GIVEN** a payment webhook is received multiple times (Stripe retries)
- **WHEN** the system processes subsequent webhooks
- **THEN** the operation is idempotent and subscription state remains consistent

### Error Handling - Email Verification Timeout
- **GIVEN** a user hasn't verified their email within 24 hours
- **WHEN** they try to access their account
- **THEN** they can request a new verification email with clear instructions

### Error Handling - Payment Gateway Timeout
- **GIVEN** the payment gateway times out during processing
- **WHEN** the user submits payment
- **THEN** the system shows a pending state and processes via webhook when available

## 4. Technical Context

| Aspect | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Affected Files** | `frontend/src/pages/onboarding/*`, `backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py`, `backend/src/app/api/v1/payments.py`, `backend/src/app/services/onboarding_service.py`, `backend/src/app/services/payment_service.py`, `backend/src/app/services/subscription_service.py`, `backend/src/app/models/subscription.py`, `backend/src/app/models/onboarding.py` |
| **Dependencies** | Stripe SDK, Google OAuth, Resend (email), Redis (session/cache) |
| **Constraints** | PCI DSS compliance (no card data storage), GDPR consent tracking, multi-tenant workspace isolation |
| **Patterns to Follow** | Repository → Service → API pattern, React Query for data fetching, Pydantic validation, Celery for async tasks |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL with proper foreign keys to workspaces, audit trail tables |
| **Auth Integration** | Existing JWT auth system in `backend/src/app/core/auth.py` |

## 5. Non-Goals

- **Mobile app onboarding**: This specification covers web-only; mobile apps are future work
- **Enterprise SSO/SAML**: Only Google OAuth for social login; enterprise SSO is separate
- **Multi-currency dynamic pricing**: Initial release supports USD/INR only with static conversion
- **AI plan recommendations**: Plan selection is manual; AI recommendations are future enhancement
- **CRM integration**: Lead nurturing via CRM is out of scope
- **Affiliate/referral tracking**: Not included in initial implementation
- **Free trial period**: All plans require immediate payment; trial logic is separate feature

## 6. Implementation Tasks

```tasks
## Phase 1: Database Schema & Models
- [ ] T001: Create subscription plans table with features, pricing, limits | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T002: Create subscriptions table with workspace relationship | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T003: Create onboarding_sessions table for flow state tracking | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T004: Create payment_transactions table with idempotency keys | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T005: Create email_verifications table with tokens and expiry | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T006: Create user_consents table for GDPR/terms tracking | File: backend/migrations/versions/
- [ ] T007: Add SQLAlchemy models for all new tables | File: backend/src/app/models/onboarding.py
- [ ] T008: Add SQLAlchemy models for subscriptions | File: backend/src/app/models/subscription.py

## Phase 2: Backend Services & Repositories
- [ ] T009: Create PlanRepository for subscription plan queries | File: backend/src/app/repositories/plan_repository.py
- [ ] T010: Create SubscriptionRepository for subscription CRUD | File: backend/src/app/repositories/subscription_repository.py
- [ ] T011: Create OnboardingRepository for session management | File: backend/src/app/repositories/onboarding_repository.py
- [ ] T012: Create PaymentService with Stripe integration | File: backend/src/app/services/payment_service.py
- [ ] T013: Create SubscriptionService for tier activation | File: backend/src/app/services/subscription_service.py
- [ ] T014: Create OnboardingService for flow orchestration | File: backend/src/app/services/onboarding_service.py
- [ ] T015: Create EmailVerificationService | File: backend/src/app/services/email_verification_service.py

## Phase 3: Backend API Endpoints
- [ ] T016: Create GET /api/v1/plans endpoint for plan listing | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/plans.py
- [ ] T017: Create POST /api/v1/onboarding/start endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py
- [ ] T018: Create POST /api/v1/onboarding/register endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py
- [ ] T019: Create POST /api/v1/onboarding/verify-email endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py
- [ ] T020: Create POST /api/v1/payments/create-intent endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/payments.py
- [ ] T021: Create POST /api/v1/payments/webhook endpoint (Stripe) | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/payments.py
- [ ] T022: Create POST /api/v1/onboarding/complete-setup endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py
- [ ] T023: Create GET /api/v1/onboarding/status endpoint | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/onboarding.py

## Phase 4: Email & Background Tasks
- [ ] T024: Create email templates for verification | File: backend/src/app/templates/emails/
- [ ] T025: Create email templates for payment confirmation | File: backend/src/app/templates/emails/
- [ ] T026: Create email templates for welcome/activation | File: backend/src/app/templates/emails/
- [ ] T027: Create Celery task for sending verification emails | File: backend/src/app/tasks/email_tasks.py
- [ ] T028: Create Celery task for payment confirmation emails | File: backend/src/app/tasks/email_tasks.py
- [ ] T029: Create Celery task for subscription activation | File: backend/src/app/tasks/subscription_tasks.py

## Phase 5: Frontend - Shared Components
- [ ] T030: Create PlanCard component with feature display | File: frontend/src/components/features/onboarding/PlanCard.tsx
- [ ] T031: Create PlanComparison component | File: frontend/src/components/features/onboarding/PlanComparison.tsx
- [ ] T032: Create BillingToggle component (monthly/annual) | File: frontend/src/components/features/onboarding/BillingToggle.tsx
- [ ] T033: Create OnboardingProgress component | File: frontend/src/components/features/onboarding/OnboardingProgress.tsx
- [ ] T034: Create PasswordStrengthIndicator component | File: frontend/src/components/features/onboarding/PasswordStrengthIndicator.tsx

## Phase 6: Frontend - Onboarding Pages
- [ ] T035: Create PlanSelectionPage with pricing grid | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/PlanSelectionPage.tsx
- [ ] T036: Create RegistrationPage with form validation | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/RegistrationPage.tsx
- [ ] T037: Create EmailVerificationPage | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/EmailVerificationPage.tsx
- [ ] T038: Create PaymentPage with Stripe Elements | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/PaymentPage.tsx
- [ ] T039: Create SetupWizardPage with step navigation | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/SetupWizardPage.tsx
- [ ] T040: Create OnboardingCompletePage | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/OnboardingCompletePage.tsx

## Phase 7: Frontend - Hooks & State
- [ ] T041: Create useOnboarding hook for flow state | File: frontend/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts
- [ ] T042: Create usePlans hook for plan fetching | File: frontend/src/hooks/usePlans.ts
- [ ] T043: Create usePayment hook for Stripe integration | File: frontend/src/hooks/usePayment.ts
- [ ] T044: Create OnboardingContext for cross-page state | File: frontend/src/contexts/OnboardingContext.tsx

## Phase 8: Google OAuth Integration
- [ ] T045: Add Google OAuth callback handler | File: backend/src/app/api/v1/auth.py
- [ ] T046: Create useGoogleAuth hook | File: frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleAuth.ts
- [ ] T047: Add Google sign-in button to RegistrationPage | File: frontend/src/pages/onboarding/RegistrationPage.tsx

## Phase 9: Routing & Navigation
- [ ] T048: Add onboarding routes to router configuration | File: frontend/src/routes/index.tsx
- [ ] T049: Create OnboardingLayout wrapper | File: frontend/src/layouts/OnboardingLayout.tsx
- [ ] T050: Add route guards for onboarding flow | File: frontend/src/components/guards/OnboardingGuard.tsx

## Phase 10: Testing & Verification
- [ ] T051: Write backend unit tests for OnboardingService | File: backend/tests/services/test_onboarding_service.py
- [ ] T052: Write backend unit tests for PaymentService | File: backend/tests/services/test_payment_service.py
- [ ] T053: Write API integration tests for onboarding endpoints | File: backend/tests/api/test_onboarding.py
- [ ] T054: Write Playwright E2E test for complete onboarding flow | File: tests/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts
```

## 7. Success Metrics

| Metric | Target | Measurement Method |
|--------|--------|-------------------|
| **Onboarding Completion Rate** | >80% of users who start complete payment | Analytics funnel tracking |
| **Time to First Gallery** | <10 minutes from signup | Timestamp comparison |
| **Payment Success Rate** | >95% first-attempt success | Payment transaction logs |
| **Email Verification Rate** | >90% within 24 hours | Email verification table |
| **Page Load Time** | <2s for all onboarding pages | Performance monitoring |
| **Error Rate** | <1% of onboarding sessions | Error logging |

## 8. Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|------------|--------|------------|
| Stripe webhook failures | Medium | High | Implement idempotency keys, retry logic with exponential backoff, webhook signature verification |
| User abandonment mid-flow | High | Medium | Persist session state, allow resume from any step, send reminder emails |
| Email deliverability issues | Medium | Medium | Use transactional email service (Resend), implement SPF/DKIM/DMARC, monitor bounce rates |
| Google OAuth token expiry | Low | Low | Implement proper token refresh, fallback to email login |
| PCI compliance violations | Low | High | Never store card data, use Stripe Elements, regular security audits |
| Database migration failures | Low | High | Test migrations in staging, implement rollback procedures |
| High concurrent signups | Medium | Medium | Rate limiting, database connection pooling, Redis caching for plans |

---
